steps: Read the configured gRPC metadata credential header.
Strip the configured scheme prefix when present.
Stamp LatticeCredentialContext for the facade call.
ILatticeMembershipContext resolves the current subject from LatticeCredentialContext.
Read the configured gRPC metadata active-tenant header.
LatticeActiveTenantAssertion validates syntax and stamps LatticeActiveTenantContext.
TenantContextResolver validates the asserted tenant against membership before it scopes a tree name.
Read the configured gRPC metadata credential header.
Strip the configured scheme prefix when present.
Stamp LatticeCredentialContext for the facade call.
Tenant facades authorize through ILatticeAccessGate and optional ILatticeMembershipContext.
Caller opens an ambient credential and optional active-tenant scope.
RequestContext carries ol.cred and ol.atid on outgoing grain calls.
MembershipContext resolves a subject.
TenantContextResolver validates tenant assertions.
Resolve HttpContext from the tool invocation service provider.
HttpContextLatticeApiMcpActiveTenantBridge reads the configured active-tenant header.
Stamp LatticeActiveTenantContext for the tool invocation.
Remote heads re-emit the ambient tenant as outbound gRPC metadata according to MCP options.
Resolve HttpContext from the tool invocation service provider.
HttpContextLatticeApiMcpCredentialBridge requires an authenticated ASP.NET Core principal.
Read the configured credential header or use the principal id as the token for authenticated non-bearer sessions.
Stamp LatticeCredentialContext for the tool invocation.

fail_closed.rule: Missing, empty, or bare-scheme credential headers resolve to anonymous or null and downstream gates deny when authority is required.
Missing, blank, or syntactically invalid active-tenant headers stamp no active tenant; unauthorized assertions validate to the uninitialized tenant and fail closed at composition or gate seams.
